entries.name: Han Solo
entries.sourceWork: Star Wars: EpisodeIV — A New Hope (1977), black vest and DL-44 heavy blaster pistol
entries.sourceReference: Han Solo uses a DL-44 heavy blaster pistol in A New Hope. Tir précis au DL-44 is an authored single-target shot from that physical weapon; it does not manifest the MillenniumFalcon or convert a flight feat into a power.
entries.referenceUsage: Local black-vest Han sprite was inspected for costume context; its handheld terminal/hologram attack is explicitly replaced with the actual DL-44 blaster in the new native art.

entries.name: Kenshin Himura
entries.sourceWork: Rurouni Kenshin TVanime1996 — Kyoto arc, adult Kenshin with sakabatō
entries.sourceReference: Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki is the Hiten Mitsurugi-ryū battōjutsu ultimate technique. The authored poses emphasize left-foot-forward draw, physical reverse-blade sword and rotational follow-through; not a projectile or elemental power. No original frame count or live-action likeness is claimed.
